display_long_description:
Multiple game play modes, one for everyone.
Training - For those who want to hone certain skills
Challenge - For quick fun
T20 Match - For those who want a long game.

In Training you set everything: the bowler, the field and the pitch. Challenge gives you six balls to make your mark. 
T20 Match is the full 20 overs. Real physics drives both bat and ball, so every shot leaves the bat the way you swung it, and shot tracing shows exactly where you made contact, or missed.
Play it as a relaxed net session, or as serious practice before your next match.

FEATURES
• Training: choose the bowler, field placings and pitch conditions
• Challenge: a 6-ball challenge
• T20 Match: a full 20-over match
• Real physics for bat and ball
• Shot tracing and replay for every ball
• A traditional English village-ground setting
• Plays offline, no internet needed

TIP: keep your controllers in the headset's view while batting for the most accurate bat tracking.
